flash_headline: MODEL POISONING IN OPEN MODEL HUBS
flash_summary: Security teams report a wave of tampered model checkpoints seeded with hidden malicious payloads.
primary_headline: OPEN MODEL SUPPLY CHAIN UNDER ATTACK
primary_body: Security analysts are seeing coordinated campaigns where malicious actors upload altered model weights and dependency bundles. Teams deploying without signature checks are at highest risk.

cards.label: MODEL BACKDOOR
cards.body: Backdoored models can silently return poisoned outputs when triggered by specific tokens.

cards.label: DEPENDENCY SWAP
cards.body: Attackers publish lookalike packages with typosquatted names to steal credentials in CI.

special_section_body: Use model signing, lock dependencies, and run sandbox scans before promoting assets to production.
cta_text: DO YOU VERIFY YOUR MODELS BEFORE THEY SHIP?
